clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stormwind Stockade, Kam Deepfury’s severed head marks the end of a Dark Iron conspirator. His death in the prison riots answers the grievance of the dwarven defenders at Dun Modr.

Kam Deepfury was held in the Stormwind Stockade for political reasons, spared immediate execution by human diplomacy. Roggo uncovered that Deepfury had orchestrated the attack on the Thandol Span, which cost the lives of King Magni’s soldiers and Longbraid the Grim’s kin. The Ironforge mountaineers at Dun Modr could not accept his continued imprisonment. Bound to his post, Motley Garmason sent Alliance champions into the rioting prison to take Deepfury’s head and deliver dwarven vengeance.
